title: ariadne
summary: Ariadne maps a code repository into a map.json with parts, clusters and flows, using a coding agent. A local server and a 3D viewer let you explore the map, browse code, ride metro maps of functions, hear narration and chat with an agent.

parts.details: It lists source files with git, picks project folders (or top-level dirs) and balances them into batches. The user must choose the agent and model first; it shows a rough token cost. Each batch runs in parallel and writes a parts file, then assemble merges them.
